item.text: {"search_note":"I found strong evidence that the Kremlin funded some social services through technocratic staffing levers, especially in rural healthcare. I did not find strong 2024 evidence that social-service management itself was broadly depoliticized, merit-based, or insulated from patronage networks outside these targeted programs.
